_research_caveat: WebFetch/direct HTTP to every pin-collector domain (pinpics.com, pinandpop.com, disneypinsblog.com, pintradingdb.com, disneypinventory.com, ebay.com, mercari.com) is blocked by this session's egress policy (HTTP 403 on CONNECT), and the session's WebSearch budget was exhausted mid-task. Identifications below therefore rest on (a) high-magnification analysis of the collector's own photo and (b) WebSearch result titles/summaries that quoted those pages. No page was fetched directly, and no eBay sold-listing comps could be retrieved, so every market price field is null and every price_confidence is "low". PinPics IDs are recorded only where a search-result title literally displayed the PP number.

pins.name: Mickey and Minnie Ear Headband Pin — Hidden Disney 2025
pins.series: WDW Hidden Disney Series 2025 Wave A: Ear Headbands
pins.notes: One of the five common pins in the seven-pin WDW Hidden Disney 2025 Ear Headbands set (commons: Mickey and Minnie, Ariel, Park Treats, Stitch, Pirates of the Caribbean; CHASER: Orange Bird; SUPER CHASER: Cinderella Castle). Cast-lanyard trading pin — not sold individually at release; in April 2025 silver mystery pouches with two random 2025 Hidden Disney pins sold for $19.99. Pin & Pop catalogues the WDW set as IDs 90918-90924. PinPics ID taken from the search-result title 'PP170931 - WDW - Mickey and Minnie - Earbands - Hidden Disney 2025'.
pins.board_note: Ear-headband grid, row 1 left column — black Mickey ears, red shorts band with two white buttons across the bottom, large yellow bow; small Hidden Mickey silhouette on the right ear.

pins.name: Ariel / The Little Mermaid Ear Headband Pin — Hidden Disney 2025
pins.series: WDW Hidden Disney Series 2025 Wave A: Ear Headbands
pins.notes: Pin & Pop lists this as pin 90918 in the WDW Hidden Disney Series 2025 Ear Headbands set. Artwork on the board matches an Ariel-themed headband: lavender scallop-shell left ear with a pink starfish, teal mermaid-scale right ear with a spiral conch and a starfish bow, red/coral headband arms (Ariel's hair colour).
pins.board_note: Ear-headband grid, row 2 left column — lavender scallop shell + pink starfish on the left ear, teal fish-scale ear with a white/aqua conch and starfish bow, coral-red headband arms; Hidden Mickey on the left shell.

pins.name: Stitch Ear Headband Pin — Hidden Disney 2025
pins.series: WDW Hidden Disney Series 2025 Wave A: Ear Headbands
pins.notes: Pin & Pop lists Stitch as pin 90920 in the WDW Hidden Disney 2025 Ear Headbands set; a Disney Pinventory listing (item 42805) describes it as 'Stitch's ears overlaid on a Mickey ear with Stitch's blue and pink colouring', which matches the board pin (big pointed blue-violet ears over round Mickey ears, pink/peach muzzle centred on the band). Identification is by artwork match only — the pin's own text was not readable in the photo.
pins.board_note: Ear-headband grid, row 2 right column — two large pointed blue/violet Stitch ears with white banding over round ears, peach-pink muzzle shape in the centre of the band; Hidden Mickey on the right ear.

pins.name: Pirates of the Caribbean Ear Headband Pin — Hidden Disney 2025
pins.series: WDW Hidden Disney Series 2025 Wave A: Ear Headbands
pins.notes: A Disney Pinventory listing (item 42804, 'Hidden Disney 2025: Ear Headbands Pin - Pirates of the Caribbean') is described as standard black Mickey ears with a brown-and-yellow pirate hat in the centre. The board pin shows dark ears with a wide pirate hat bearing a white skull emblem plus a plume; the hat reads mauve/pink here, likely a warm-light colour shift, so the match is probable rather than certain.
pins.board_note: Ear-headband grid, row 3 right column — dark grey/black ears, wide pirate hat across the top with a white skull emblem and a swirled plume on the upper left; Hidden Mickey on the left ear.

pins.name: Marie Ear Headband Pin — Hidden Disney 2025 (Disneyland)
pins.series: DLR Hidden Disney Series 2025 Wave A: Ear Headbands
pins.notes: Pin & Pop lists Marie as pin 90925 in the seven-pin DLR Hidden Disney Series 2025 Wave A: Ear Headbands set (other known members: Mickey Mouse Balloons Ears 90926, Winnie the Pooh 90927, Cheshire Cat 90928, CHASER Steamboat Willie 90931, SUPER CHASER Sleeping Beauty Castle 90932). DLR pins were cast-trading only at first, later sold as a two-pack mystery pouch.
pins.board_note: Ear-headband grid, row 5 left column — all-white pin, round Mickey ears with pointed white cat ears inside, pale pink bow and a small white plume on top; Hidden Mickey on the right ear.

pins.name: Cheshire Cat Ear Headband Pin — Hidden Disney 2025 (Disneyland)
pins.series: DLR Hidden Disney Series 2025 Wave A: Ear Headbands
pins.notes: Pin & Pop lists Cheshire Cat as pin 90928 in the DLR Hidden Disney Series 2025 Wave A: Ear Headbands set. Board artwork matches: one ear is the Cheshire Cat's pink-and-magenta striped curled tail, the other is his grinning face.
pins.board_note: Ear-headband grid, row 6 left column — pink/magenta striped curled tail forming the left ear, Cheshire Cat's grinning face forming the right ear, deep magenta headband arms; Hidden Mickey on the left ear.

pins.name: Star Tours Ear Headband Pin (Hidden Disney series, wave undetermined)
pins.notes: Subject is certain — the pin reads 'STAR TOURS' with the Star Tours logo, a Starspeeder / R2-D2 panel on the left ear and a Rebel Alliance insignia on the band. Series is NOT confirmed: Star Tours does not appear in either published seven-pin 2025 Wave A Ear Headbands checklist (WDW or DLR), so this is likely a different wave or year of the same Hidden Disney 'Ear Headbands' format. Construction (white outline, small Hidden Mickey icon on an ear) matches the Hidden Disney ear-headband format.
pins.board_note: Ear-headband grid, row 1 right column — white ears, left ear shows a Starspeeder/R2-D2 panel, right ear reads 'STAR TOURS' with the logo, red-and-white Rebel insignia medallion centred on a lavender band.

pins.name: White Bow with Blue Gem Ear Headband Pin (likely Cinderella; unconfirmed)
pins.notes: Same Hidden Disney ear-headband construction (white outline plus Hidden Mickey icon on the right ear). Artwork is black Mickey ears with a large pale-blue-and-white bow set with a single oval blue cabochon — most consistent with a Cinderella-themed headband, but the pin is not on either 2025 Wave A checklist I could see, and the design was not matched to a catalogued pin. Character attribution is inference from the artwork only.
pins.board_note: Ear-headband grid, row 3 left column — black/charcoal ears with a big pale-blue and white bow, single oval blue gem at the bow's knot, pale blue headband arms; Hidden Mickey on the right ear.

pins.name: Maleficent Ear Headband Pin (series undetermined)
pins.notes: Subject is unambiguous (Maleficent's black-and-purple striped horns over a green flame halo). Series unresolved. Two candidate homes were found but neither confirmed: (1) a Hidden Disney 'Ear Headbands' wave — the board pin does appear to carry a Hidden Mickey icon on the right horn, which would rule the second option out; (2) the Disney Villains Ear Headband Pin Set, a four-pin Limited Release (Maleficent, Evil Queen, Hades, Jafar) at $29.99 that went on sale 11 April 2023 at Disneyland and later at Walt Disney World. Do not treat either as settled.
pins.board_note: Ear-headband grid, row 4 right column — Maleficent's tall black-and-purple striped horns rising from a black 'M' band, pale green flame shapes behind each horn; Hidden Mickey on the right horn base.

pins.name: Unidentified white ear headband pin with pink bow and plume
pins.notes: Hidden Disney ear-headband format (white outline, Hidden Mickey icon on the right ear) but the character is not identifiable from the photo — it is an all-white/ivory pin with only faint pink line detail, showing large round ears, a small pink bow and an upright plume or feather. Candidates considered and NOT confirmed: Dumbo, Marie (a separate Marie pin is already on the board two rows down), a Minnie 'white bow' headband. Left deliberately unnamed rather than guessed.
pins.board_note: Ear-headband grid, row 4 left column — almost entirely white/ivory pin, large round ears with faint pink outlines, small pink bow at centre and a white upright plume; Hidden Mickey on the right ear.

pins.name: Unidentified ear headband pin with orange ribbed wings (possibly Figment)
pins.notes: Hidden Disney ear-headband format with a Hidden Mickey icon on the right wing. The ears are two orange, ribbed, scalloped wing shapes on a pale lavender band. Best guess is a Figment (Epcot) headband — Figment merchandise pairs a lavender band with orange dragon wings — but this was not verified against any catalogue entry, and an Orange Bird reading (Orange Bird is the published CHASER in the WDW 2025 Ear Headbands set) cannot be ruled out. Recorded as unidentified.
pins.board_note: Ear-headband grid, row 5 right column — two orange ribbed/scalloped wing shapes as ears on a pale lavender headband; Hidden Mickey on the right wing.

pins.name: Unidentified gold-tone ear headband pin — navy ears with white daisies and yellow-green bow
pins.notes: One of three ear-headband pins on the bottom row that are visibly a DIFFERENT series from the eleven above: gold-tone base metal (not silver/white), no Hidden Mickey icon, dark navy ears with dense floral/pattern fills. Most likely from one of the Disney Parks ear-headband mystery/blind-box pin collections that reproduce real merchandise headbands, but no catalogue entry was matched. Not identified.
pins.board_note: Bottom ear-headband row, leftmost of three — gold-trimmed pin, navy ears each with a large white daisy, pale yellow-green bow with trailing petals, gold headband arms.

pins.name: Unidentified gold-tone ear headband pin — navy ears with orange flowers and patterned bow
pins.notes: Second of the three gold-tone bottom-row ear-headband pins. Same construction family as the other two (gold base metal, no Hidden Mickey icon). Series not identified; the ornate gold filigree and hibiscus-like flowers suggest a tropical or festival-themed real headband being reproduced, but nothing was corroborated.
pins.board_note: Bottom ear-headband row, centre of three — gold-trimmed pin, dark ears with gold filigree and a red-orange hibiscus-style flower on each ear, tan/gold patterned bow with green centre leaves.

pins.name: Unidentified gold-tone ear headband pin — blue shell ears with teal beaded-mesh bow
pins.notes: Third of the three gold-tone bottom-row ear-headband pins. Blue-violet fan/scallop shell ears on a navy field with white dots, and a bow rendered as teal beaded or sequinned mesh. Series not identified.
pins.board_note: Bottom ear-headband row, rightmost of three — gold-trimmed pin, blue-violet scallop-shell ears on navy with white dots, teal beaded-mesh bow, pale teal headband arms.

pins.name: Unidentified Disney castle pin — royal blue with pink blossoms
pins.notes: One of three castle-silhouette pins stacked vertically. All three share the same die-cut outline with an archway notch at the bottom centre and differ only in the fill, which is the signature of a single set. A Disney Pins Blog summary states the Hidden Disney 2025 Wave B collection includes a 'Castles' series alongside Ear Hats, Character D, Treats, Color Stories and Bubble Wands — that is the strongest candidate home for these three, but no checklist or image was retrievable to confirm it. Which specific castle (Cinderella vs Sleeping Beauty) is not determinable from the photo.
pins.board_note: Castle stack, top of three — royal-blue castle silhouette filled with dark blue swirls and small pink blossoms, white-metal outline, small Mickey mark near the bottom right.

pins.name: Unidentified Disney castle pin — silver/grey with light beams
pins.notes: Second of the three matched castle-silhouette pins. Fill is a pale grey/silver castle with white and gold searchlight beams and a very tall centre spire. Same series-candidate caveat as the other two castles (possibly Hidden Disney 2025 Wave B 'Castles', unconfirmed).
pins.board_note: Castle stack, middle of three — pale grey/silver castle with white and gold light-beam streaks radiating across it and a tall slim centre spire.

pins.name: Unidentified Disney castle pin — blue with Mickey-head fireworks
pins.notes: Third of the three matched castle-silhouette pins. Fill is medium blue with outlined Mickey-head shapes (one white, one pink/red), starbursts and sparkle dots — reads as a fireworks/celebration treatment. Same series-candidate caveat as the other two castles.
pins.board_note: Castle stack, bottom of three — medium-blue castle with two outlined Mickey-head shapes (white upper centre, pink lower left), snowflake/starburst sparkles throughout.

pins.name: Gothic 'D' pin with two pink drinks (series undetermined)
pins.notes: One of four pins on the board built from the same ornate gothic capital 'D' with subject art overlapping its right side. A Disney Pins Blog summary lists 'Character D' as one of the Hidden Disney 2025 Wave B series, which is the strongest candidate home for all four, but no checklist was retrievable. This one shows two tall footed glasses of pink drink with whipped-cream tops and small blue garnishes, clinked together, with pale flowers above — a park-treat/beverage subject rather than a character; the specific treat and film (if any) is not identified.
pins.board_note: 'D' pin column, top of four — white/ivory gothic 'D', two footed glasses of pink drink with whipped-cream domes and blue garnishes clinking to the right of the letter.

pins.name: Gothic 'D' pin with pale blue figure and lamp (series undetermined)
pins.notes: Second of the four gothic-'D' pins. Subject is a pale blue/white figure with large round eyes and a banded body, a spiral shape at its upper left and a small orange/gold vessel at its lower right. Candidates considered: Genie emerging from the lamp (Aladdin) and the hookah-smoking Caterpillar (Alice in Wonderland). Neither could be confirmed from the photo, so the subject is left unidentified.
pins.board_note: 'D' pin column, second of four — pale blue/white gothic 'D', round-eyed banded figure with a spiral above it and a small orange lamp-like vessel at the lower right.

pins.name: Gothic 'D' pin with Elsa (series undetermined)
pins.notes: Third of the four gothic-'D' pins; subject is clearly Elsa from Frozen (pale hair worn over one shoulder, blue-lilac gown) standing against a teal/blue letter. Series unconfirmed — 'Character D' in the Hidden Disney 2025 Wave B line-up is the leading candidate.
pins.board_note: 'D' pin column, third of four — teal/blue gothic 'D' with Elsa standing to its right in a blue-lilac gown, hair over one shoulder.

pins.name: Gothic 'D' pin with Lion King cub (series undetermined)
pins.notes: Fourth of the four gothic-'D' pins. Subject is a young Lion King cub in golden yellow beside an orange letter; whether it is Simba or Nala cannot be told at this resolution, so no character is asserted. Series unconfirmed ('Character D', Hidden Disney 2025 Wave B, is the leading candidate).
pins.board_note: 'D' pin column, bottom of four — orange gothic 'D' with a seated golden lion cub (Simba or Nala) to its right; this is the item previously read as a separate standalone 'Nala/Simba' pin.

pins.name: Unidentified Disney bookmark pin with fabric tassel — Dumbo circus scene
pins.notes: One of three tall rectangular pins with rounded top corners, a cut-out at the top and a real fabric tassel threaded through it — the shape of a bookmark, not a bubble wand, though the Hidden Disney 2025 Wave B line-up does include a 'Bubble Wands' series that could not be checked. Art is a pink-and-white striped circus tent over a scalloped valance with Dumbo below. Series not identified.
pins.board_note: Tassel/bookmark trio, leftmost — tall white rectangle, pink-and-blue striped big-top tent at the top, Dumbo at the bottom, grey-white fabric tassel hanging from the top cut-out.

pins.name: Unidentified Disney bookmark pin with fabric tassel — pale blue sky scene
pins.notes: Second of the three tassel bookmark pins. Pale blue sky with white clouds and a small bird, and a light figure with flowers in the lower half — too washed out in the photo to name the character. Same unidentified series as the other two.
pins.board_note: Tassel/bookmark trio, centre — tall pale-blue rectangle, white clouds and a small flying bird at the top, a pale figure with flowers below, teal fabric tassel.

pins.name: Unidentified Disney bookmark pin with fabric tassel — Bambi-style meadow scene
pins.notes: Third of the three tassel bookmark pins. Pale blue sky with clouds and a bird, and a slender fawn-like figure standing among flowers at the bottom — reads as Bambi, but the property attribution is inference from the silhouette only. Series not identified.
pins.board_note: Tassel/bookmark trio, rightmost — tall pale-blue rectangle, clouds and a bird at the top, a fawn-like figure standing in flowers at the bottom, pink fabric tassel.

pins.name: Unidentified pink monochrome character-cluster pin (upper)
pins.notes: One of a pair of near-identical-format pins rendered entirely in pink/white line art, each showing two or three animal characters grouped together (long-eared and round-eared figures). A Disney Pins Blog summary lists 'Color Stories' among the Hidden Disney 2025 Wave B series, which would fit a single-colour treatment like this, but no checklist or image was retrievable and the characters cannot be named from the photo. Not identified.
pins.board_note: Pink cluster pair, upper pin — all-pink-and-white cluster of two or three animal characters, a long-eared figure lying at the left and a larger round-eared figure at the right.

pins.name: Unidentified pink monochrome character-cluster pin (lower)
pins.notes: Companion to the upper pink cluster pin — same all-pink line-art treatment, same scale, clearly the same series. Characters not identifiable from the photo; series not confirmed (see the note on the upper pin).
pins.board_note: Pink cluster pair, lower pin — all-pink-and-white cluster, long-eared figure at the left and a large round-eared mouse-like head at the right.

pins.name: Pink monochrome princess pin (reads as Aurora)
pins.notes: Same all-pink line-art treatment as the two cluster pins nearby, so probably the same series. A long-haired princess in a floor-length gown with a trailing skirt; the pink gown and loose long hair read as Aurora from Sleeping Beauty, but because the whole pin is monochrome pink the dress colour carries no information and the identification is a silhouette guess only.
pins.board_note: Below the pink cluster pair, left — all-pink-and-white princess standing in profile, long loose hair, full-length gown with a trailing skirt.

pins.name: Unidentified pink round wide-eyed character pin
pins.notes: Same pink monochrome family as the cluster and princess pins. A round-bodied character with two very large bulging eyes, a wide open grin, small stubby arms and a small pointed tail. Candidates considered and rejected as unverifiable: Cheshire Cat (the collector's initial read), Mr. Toad, a Little Mermaid fish. Recorded as unidentified rather than guessed.
pins.board_note: Below the pink cluster pair, right — solid pink round-bodied character with two oversized white bulging eyes, wide grin, stubby arms and a small pointed tail on the left.

pins.name: Gus (Gus Gus) Pin — Cinderella
pins.notes: Character identification is solid from the artwork: the plump brown mouse from Cinderella, seated, wearing a green-teal stocking cap, a yellow shirt and red slippers. No series marking is visible and no catalogue entry could be retrieved (all pin databases were unreachable), so year, origin and edition remain unknown. Note: this pin sits at the bottom of the right-hand ear-headband column but is NOT an ear-headband pin.
pins.board_note: Bottom of the right-hand ear-headband column (row 6 right) — seated plump brown mouse with big pale ears, teal stocking cap, yellow shirt, red slippers.

pins.name: Pascal Pin — Tangled
pins.notes: Character identification is solid: green chameleon with a tightly curled tail, standing profile — Pascal from Tangled. The pin has gold-tone metal outlines, unlike the silver/white-outlined Hidden Disney pins nearby, so it is probably from a different (unidentified) release. No catalogue entry retrievable.
pins.board_note: Right of the 'D' pin column, upper — green chameleon in profile with a tightly spiralled tail, gold-tone outlines.

pins.name: Donald Duck Pin
pins.notes: Character identification is certain: Donald Duck standing, in his blue sailor top and cap with a red bow tie, arms folded. Which release this is could not be determined — no series mark is legible and every pin database was unreachable. The classic drawing style and glitter-flecked bow tie suggest an older or retro-styled pin.
pins.board_note: Right of the Walt Disney Family Museum pin, bottom row of the Disney cluster — Donald Duck standing, blue sailor cap and top, red bow tie, arms folded.

pins.name: The Walt Disney Family Museum Logo Pin
pins.park_specific: The Walt Disney Family Museum, San Francisco
pins.notes: The pin's own text is fully legible in the photo: a red rectangle reading 'THE WALT DISNEY FAMILY MUSEUM' in four stacked lines of black sans-serif capitals — the museum's logo lock-up. This is museum-gift-shop merchandise from the Walt Disney Family Museum in San Francisco's Presidio, not a Disney Parks trading pin, so it has no PinPics/series identity. Year and price could not be researched.
pins.board_note: Bottom row of the Disney cluster, left of Donald — small red rectangular pin reading THE / WALT DISNEY / FAMILY / MUSEUM in black capitals.

pins.name: Unidentified Disney food pin — boba / bubble tea drink
pins.notes: Sits alone at the far right of the board, well separated from the rest of the Disney cluster, paired with the sushi pin below it. Gold-tone outlines, glitter fill. Shows a pink drink cup with black boba pearls, a domed white cream top with a gold dome lid, green and yellow straws, against a teal scalloped/glittered burst. No character, text or series mark is visible; not identified. A Disney food/snack mystery series or a Disney Munchlings-style release are both plausible but unverified.
pins.board_note: Far right of the board, upper of two — round pin with a teal glittered scalloped background, pink boba drink cup with black pearls, white cream dome and green/yellow straws.

pins.name: Unidentified Disney food pin — sushi character in an orange hat
pins.notes: Companion to the boba pin at the far right of the board. A pale pink square block (rice/tofu) with a small blue-and-orange smiling face wearing a wide orange brimmed hat, mounted on a blue base with dark chevron marks. The character is stylised well past recognisability at this resolution; no text or series mark visible. Not identified — a Disney Munchlings-style or Tokyo Disney Resort food pin are both plausible but unverified.
pins.board_note: Far right of the board, lower of two — pale pink square with a small blue/orange smiling face in a wide orange brimmed hat, sitting on a blue base with dark chevrons.
